persona: Beginner beatmaker new to RILL; aiming for a 30-second hip-hop-style loop
evaluation_type: Independent simulated beginner usability session, not a human study

method.app_interaction: Mouse clicks, double-clicks, drags and one scroll only; screenshots for discovery
conditions: Null audio output: no audible playback judgement
Only instrument available was the lab-provided native VST3 Rill Lab Sine; not third-party plugin validation

completion.audio: Four stock Circuit rhythm audio clips, final clip trimmed slightly before 30 seconds
completion.midi: Six mouse-drawn notes in a two-bar phrase, duplicated to seven two-bar clips; 14 bars at 112 BPM
completion.vst: Rill Lab Sine explicitly shown as Format VST3 in Device library and assigned to New instrument track
completion.musical_limitations: A simple repeated phrase over the stock rhythm; hip-hop intent cannot be confirmed by listening under null audio.

ratings_scale: 1 to 5; higher means more of the named quality. Higher confusion is worse.

rating_notes.easy_to_use: Initial MIDI creation, pencil notes, duplication and export were straightforward; exact trimming and changing values caused detours.
rating_notes.how_cool_it_looks: Cohesive dark teal appearance, clear waveforms and readable controls. Similar clip colors and sparse pitch labels make scanning less expressive.
rating_notes.how_fast_it_is: Created and exported in about 6.5 minutes. UI actions generally responded promptly; rendering finished after the visible eight-second elapsed status and before the next check. No formal latency benchmark.
rating_notes.how_confusing_it_is: Toolbar reflow, context-sensitive tool changes, beat versus bar values and unclear selection persistence required checks.
rating_notes.feature_completeness: Audio, real VST MIDI, note editing, duplication, project saving and both export formats worked. Mouse-only exact numeric entry and naming are incomplete.

findings.title: Exact numeric properties are keyboard dependent
findings.observed: Duration opens a text field; scrolling and dragging the value did not change it. No visible increment/decrement controls.
findings.impact: I spent about a minute retrying exact clip trimming and left audio 0.25 beat short while the MIDI determines the 30-second project length.
findings.recommendation: Add mouse-operable stepper or scrub controls for beat/time values, with displayed seconds and useful increments.

findings.title: Tool switching reflows the note toolbar
findings.observed: Pencil selection moved Length from the left second row to the right first row. My subsequent click in the old area opened Scale.
findings.impact: Interrupted early note entry and made controls feel unstable.
findings.recommendation: Keep shared controls in stable locations across Select/Pencil, or reserve a stable row for note length/grid options.

findings.title: Active tools change across editors
findings.observed: The audio editor opened with Cursor active. Returning to arranger required checking and restoring Select during trimming attempts.
findings.impact: A drag may seek/select time instead of resizing a clip after returning from a different editor.
findings.recommendation: Preserve each editor workspace tool independently and make edge resize affordances visible.

findings.title: VST preview failure looks like instrument failure
findings.observed: Device library shows Preview failed in the navigation and Preview Failed in details; assignment still succeeds.
findings.impact: A new user may assume the only instrument is broken.
findings.recommendation: Explain unavailable artwork/preview separately from load/play readiness. This specific plugin intentionally has no custom UI; avoid treating it as general VST playback failure.

findings.title: Mouse-only project naming lacks an option
findings.observed: Save and export use text filename fields; I retained Midnight circuit and generic New pattern labels.
findings.impact: Cannot easily personalize or distinguish the composition under the strict mouse-only constraint.
findings.recommendation: Provide an on-screen input option or useful generated unique names when mouse-only accessibility is a supported goal.

findings.title: Musical timing uses multiple units without conversion in properties
findings.observed: Ruler labels bars plus seconds, while properties show Beat 49.00 and duration 7.75 beats; arrangement range shows Beats 1.00-17.00.
findings.impact: A first-time producer must translate bars and beats to find a 30-second endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Show bars/beats and seconds together, and expose arrangement duration before export.

positives: Empty-space Double-click for MIDI hint directly led to instrument assignment
Pencil drag created notes with visible pitch names and automatically extended the pattern
Context menu Duplicate and Fit made arrangement expansion fast
Export WAV accurately showed 0:30.000 and offered effect-tail control
Save, WAV export and MIDI export completed with mouse-only defaults
